Modern Coastal Escape in Inlet Beach – Walk to the Beach & Shops

“Hook, Weim & Sinker” is a stunning vacation home in the neighborhood of Sunset Key on the Florida Panhandle. The two story craftsman style home offers 2,068 square feet of luminous living space and four ample bedroom suites

Nestled in the charming Inlet Beach community along Florida’s world famous Emerald Coast this beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home offers a stylish and comfortable retreat just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of the Gulf. Whether you’re unwinding on the balcony or exploring nearby 5 star shops and restaurants, this home is the ideal setting for your next coastal escape.

Why You’ll Love It Here
• Prime Location – Just a short walk or bike ride to Inlet Beach access and the upscale shopping and dining of 30Avenue.
• Crisp & New – With four beautifully appointed bedrooms, multiple living spaces, and modern chic décor, this home comfortably accommodates multigenerational families.
• Chef’s Kitchen – Fully equipped with high-end appliances, ample counter space, walk in pantry and everything you need to prepare meals during your stay.
• Private Retreats – Each bedroom features plush bedding, walk in closets, smart tv’s, and thoughtful touches to ensure a restful stay.
• Outdoor Living – Relax on the covered balcony, enjoy morning coffee with Gulf breezes on the outdoor sectional, or gather for evening cocktails as the sun sets while cooking dinner with the gas grill.
• Close to 30A Hot Spots – Minutes from Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and Seacrest, where you’ll find world-class dining, boutique shopping, and live entertainment.

The Layout
• Main Floor: Open-concept living and dining area, chef’s kitchen, and access to an King size primary room with ensuite and walk-in shower.
• Upper Levels: three spacious bedrooms including a luxurious primary suite with a private bathroom. Secondary living space with board games, second floor balcony and smart tv.

Extras to Enjoy
• High-speed WiFi
• Smart TVs
• Washer & dryer
• Beach gear for your convenience
Workspace with desk and chair

Green space in the spacious front yard for the fur babies

About Us:
30A Sea Story is a locally owned and operated boutique management company dedicated to providing exceptional, personalized customer service. Whether you’re seeking insider tips from locals or prefer a more hands-off hosting experience, we let you take the lead while remaining readily available to enhance your stay.

Spring Break Curfew Notice:
Please be advised that March 1 – April 19, a 7:00 PM curfew for unaccompanied minors under the age of 18 will be in effect in coordination with the Walton County Sheriff`s Office.
This policy applies to Seaside, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and the majority of communities along 30A, all of which are enforcing these Spring Break safety regulations in unison with local law enforcement.
Guests are responsible for ensuring all members of their party comply with community guidelines and local regulations.
PLEASE NOTE: WE DO NOT RENT TO STUDENT GROUPS, AGE OF PRIMARY RENTER MUST BE 23 OR OLDER AND RESIDING IN PROPERTY DURING STAY.

1. Smoking is NOT allowed. Evidence of smoking in the unit after guest departure will be subject to an additional cleaning fee charged to the guest who the reservation is under.
2. People other than those noted in the booking may not stay overnight in the property. Any other person in the property is the sole responsibility of Guest.
3. All our properties are privately owned; property management and the owners are not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the premises or its facilities. Property management and the homeowners are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the guest. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that all guests are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the premises and recreational gear provided with the premises or others whom they invite to use the premise.
4. Keep the property and all furnishings in good order.
5. Only use appliances for their intended uses.
6. Bed linens and bath towels are included in the home. Please do not use rental houses linens at the beach or pool. Beach towels are not provided in the home.
7. Please know we do not rent to student groups or to guests under the age of 25. Guest whose name is on the reservation must be present for the duration of the stay.
8. This IS a pet friendly property. Guests must notify 30A Sea Story that they are bringing pets (no more than 2) when booking. A non refundable pet fee is required.

*DEPARTURE CHECKLIST:
• Empty refrigerator of all perishables. Remove all garbage from the home and take to exterior trash bins.
• Load any dirty dishes in the dishwasher and begin the wash cycle (use dishwasher detergent).
• Do not strip beds, but DO collect all the used towels and place in the laundry room.
• Check all drawers and closets for any personal items.
• Turn off all lights and make sure exterior doors are locked. Make sure beach cruiser bikes are locked.
• Check out on time, no later than 10am CT firm. If you’re leaving prior to 10am CT please text 30A Sea Story at the number listed on your arrival details so the cleaning crew can enter the home. THANK YOU!

*Homes left in complete disarray will be subject to an additional cleaning fee. Listing sites will be provided with photographs.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
